description: This PHP file defines the AcceptanceTester class used in the testing framework for SuiteCRM, providing methods to facilitate automated acceptance testing such as login, logout, navigation, and assertions.

classes.name: AcceptanceTester
classes.description: A specialized tester class extending Codeception's Actor, providing custom methods for SuiteCRM acceptance testing such as login, navigation, and UI assertions.

methods.name: getFaker
methods.description: Returns an instance of Faker\Generator for generating fake data in tests.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login action with provided username and password.

methods.name: loginAsAdmin
methods.description: Logs in as an administrator using stored admin credentials.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user via the user menu.

methods.name: dontSeeMissingLabels
methods.description: Asserts that labels starting with 'LBL_' are not visible.

methods.name: dontSeeErrors
methods.description: Checks that common error/warning messages are not visible on the page.

methods.name: visitPage
methods.description: Navigates to a specific SuiteCRM module page with optional record ID.
